lines.en: : Huh...
: Did I take a wrong turn somewhere?
: This place doesn’t seem familiar at all...
I can see several spotlights off in the distance, aimed at what looks like a giant letter T.
T is my least favorite letter in the alphabet.
Have I ever told you that?
It seems rare that you can even form a sentence without one.
What a selfish letter T is.
I take a step closer to get a better look at the worst letter in the alphabet.
: Is this...snow?
It’s summer right now. Water shouldn't be able to freeze.
: You’ve been born twice and yet question the snow?
: Curious.
: What are you doing here?
: Learning to spell.
The girl from the room with clocks speaks out to me from behind the letter T.
Her voice is easily recognizable, like nails on a chalkboard mixed with a dentist’s drill.
But it’s strangely calming for some reason I can’t figure out.
: Aren’t you going to come closer?
She beckons me to the front of my least favorite letter.
: ...Hello?
: Who’s there?
: Everyone and no one.
: The beginning and the end.
: Why don’t you take a look for yourself?
: Step forward and taste me.
Legs.
The girl above me, who was speaking just seconds ago, must have been nailed here recently.
The muscles in her thighs are still twitching.
I hold back the temptation to reach out and touch her.
Something tells me that taking her down from there would only hurt her more.
Besides, she seems happy up there.
Even if I’ve only seen her legs.
: There is something buried underneath your feet.
: Like...right here?
: Am I supposed to start digging?
: If that's what you want to do, yes.
: Dig until your nails crack.
: Let the parasites inside.
My eyes shift upward and find something beautiful.
From this angle, she looks a lot like one of my niece's friends.
What was her name again?
Maya

: Hey...do you hear anything right now?
: I can make out someone's voice, but-
: Are you talking about the one saying ‘Albatross’ and all that other weird stuff?
Another familiar voice calls out, but it speaks backwards. I have taken the liberty of rearranging the letters for you.
I winced in pain each time I had to touch the letter T.
: The end of the world will be beautiful.
: Don't you agree, Sensei?
: It’s okay. You don’t need to answer right now.
: I already know what you’re thinking.
: You do?
: I always do.
: Right now...you’re thinking you want to take that girl off of the cross and fuck her tight little pussy.
: Right, Sensei?
: That’s gross. Doesn't she look a little too much like Maya?
: Besides, she’ll be dead in a few minutes anyway.
: Oh, I know!
: You should just fuck me instead.
: I love you more than anything ever! And I bet I can make you feel really good, too!
: Look! I'll even put on my special outfit for you!
Would you like to see Ami’s special outfit?
Yes
: Take off your skin for me.
: Okay!
No
: Too bad!
: Yay! I was able to climb out this time!
: Congratulations!
: Hey, is it okay if I speak Japanese for a sec?
: Is that not what we're already speaking?
: Right now, we're speaking in the tongue of the GODS.
: The words I want to say will only hurt you if I use them in that language.
: Then Japanese is fine, I guess.
: Cool! Okay, so-
: 私を破壊する
: 希望は答えではない
: ワナだ。
: Got it?
: Can you say that again? I saw a cat and stopped paying attention.
: I can't. But that’s okay I guess. You’re a good guy and I know you’ll make the right decision regardless of whether or not you heard me.
: Thanks Ami. You are so cute.
: Thank you, Sensei! I really appreciate that!
: But anyway, I guess I’ll let you get back to your meeting with whatsername before she dries up completely.
: Much appreciated. Please wear your normal outfit next time. This one hurts my eyes.
: That's only because they aren't open all the way!
: Bye bye now!
Ami disintegrates and I am left alone with the girl once again.
: She’s a bit of a handful, isn’t she?
She doesn’t reply.
I guess she must have passed out.
It’s probably from shock.
One of the bright sides about crucifixion is that the nails help keep the blood in.
That in mind, I don’t think it would be a horrible way to go.
Much better than being eaten alive by worms, at the very least.
Plus, when you’re crucified, people can come watch and no one will bat an eye.
No one would pay to watch someone be eaten by worms. There is no market for that.
When I die, please crucify me. Like this girl.
Hang my body up over somewhere beautiful and let the vultures pick the meat off of it.
Remove my penis and reduce it to ashes.
Mix it into beverages so that my friends may drink it.
Then bury the rest of me in a field of sunflowers.
I am happy I got lost tonight.
I am happier than ever.
I move several steps toward the girl and begin to lick the wounds on her feet.
She shivers in response. I guess she’s awake again.
: My mouth is dry...
: I can imagine. It must be hard to drink when you can't use any of your appendages.
: Water...
: I don’t have any water. And I wouldn’t be able to reach your mouth even if I did.
: How about catching snowflakes on your tongue? That might work.
: ...Snowflakes?
: Yeah. It’s snowing. Though, you probably can’t see right now.
: See...
: You’re right...I...I can’t see anything...
: What happened to your eyes?
: There...
: There is something buried underneath your feet...
: What?
: There is something buried underneath your feet...
: There is something buried underneath your feet...
Gosh darn it. She’s stuck on loop again.
I insert my finger into one of the holes in her feet and instinctively become hard.
Her affection level does not rise and the erection goes away.
: There is something buried underneath your feet...
Ami was right.
The end of the world will be beautiful.
I hope to experience it with her.
But for now.
For now, I will absorb the beautiful sight before me.
As for you-
Please take these next ten seconds to think about all of the things you love.
How many things were you able to think of?
Liar.
You weren't thinking at all.
: I...can’t take much more of this...
: Please...put me out of my misery...
: Please...
: Sorry, but I’m no killer.
: Wait...
: Are...
: Are you leaving?...
: Yeah. It’s getting late and I’m kind of tired.
: 生きたい。。。
: 助けて。
: Goodnight!
: Help...
: Help me...
There are things in life that will terrify you.
Whether it be ghosts, infectious diseases, or being crucified behind an abandoned[school] building-
There are things that you will fear.
But I am here for you.
I will consume those fears and carry them myself.
Absolve yourself of your troubles and fall deeper into me.
Into this new world.
Continue to live and continue to dream-
But expect nothing.
I love you.
I really do.
The girl on the cross died that night.
Or did she?
Perhaps we all did.
Remember to forget.
